prompt: What is the "human-in-the-loop" recovery pattern in a multi-agent context?
explanation: Human-in-the-loop recovery is the escalation pattern for cases beyond automated recovery — particularly high-risk, ambiguous, or compliance-sensitive failures.

options.text: Replacing all agents with human developers
When automated recovery is insufficient or failure is high-risk, halt execution and route to a human who makes the decision before the pipeline resumes
Asking agents to vote on the best path forward
Running a third agent to adjudicate between two conflicting agents
